about: Tencent Hy4-Flash (220B-A12B incl. a 64B Engram lookup) as Strata's SQ-96 pack + Engram-Q8 + Vision on one DGX Spark, with Strata 0.2.20 (control 0.1.66, engine strata-hy4 0.1.66 linux-aarch64 CUDA 13; github.com/Niko1221/Strata). Q8 MLA KV (HY4_KV_Q8=1), 512K window, built-in DFly2 speculative decoding (adaptive width), CUDA graphs, session reuse, images in. One request at a time.
install: curl -fsSL https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/download/v0.2.20/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh (Strata control 0.1.66: strata-control-0.1.66-linux-aarch64.tar.gz sha256 4d53d7cf560373b277762f15b0119ce53eeec08fcf628fce0c2a8ffc6aa23ff4; engine strata-hy4-0.1.66-linux-aarch64-cuda-cuda13.tar.gz sha256 69981deb045e577c9285c8045e603de4b23c6f44914371c94b09f5ea90f92bfc, binary strata-hy4 sha256 2c5e04653a300f3e5dace9708508b07a6e822d99b3c748e0437e12970b92cbeb), then strata install -- --setup --family hy4-flash --model SQ-96 --context 524288 --vision yes --yes --no-start --gguf-dir <folder with the three .strata files>; setup verifies the pack SHA-256 and writes ~/.local/share/strata/install/strata-hy4-flash-sq-96.json. Run the command from ~/.local/share/strata/install.
setup: NEEDS: one DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB unified memory), ~158 GB on the local NVMe (SQ-96 89.58 GB + Engram-Q8 67.58 GB + Vision 0.93 GB, sha256 3b1c5755… / ab0cf9b3… / ef09bcef…), nothing else large on the GPU. The engine loads 89.5 GB of weights (trunk 6.58 + experts 82.93) in ~12 s, then a Q8 KV of 4.30 GB for 524,288 tokens; MemAvailable stays at 15.8-19 GB while serving. Do not run 1M on this pack: at --context 1048576 with Q8 KV, MemAvailable sits at ~7.7 GB before any request. strata-hy4 does not batch: --parallel above 1 queues requests. host_ram_gb is the measured MemAvailable drop (124 GB idle to 15.8 GB minimum during the gates).
